Measured 2026-09-01 on Windows: initialize round-trip 3.6s, init+tools/call 4.5-4.7s, peak RSS ~259 MB (interpreted via bin/release/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/simple.exe, md5 d52d770724a9f8797e98ac7819709ab9).
